definitions.explanation: A wrapped package sent by mail.

examples.japanese: {小包|こづつみ}が{届|とど}いた。
{海外|かいがい}から{小包|こづつみ}を{受|う}け{取|と}った。
examples.english: I received a package from overseas.

notes:
{小包|こづつみ} is a parcel or package sent by mail.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {小包|こづつみ}を{送|おく}る (to send a parcel)
- {小包|こづつみ}を{受|う}け{取|と}る (to receive a parcel)
- {小包|こづつみ}が{届|とど}く (a parcel arrives)

POSTAL SERVICES:
- {郵便|ゆうびん}{小包|こづつみ} (postal parcel)
- {国際|こくさい}{小包|こづつみ} (international parcel)
- {航空|こうくう}{小包|こづつみ} (airmail parcel)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {小包|こづつみ}: parcel (postal term)
- {荷物|にもつ}: package, luggage (general)
- {宅配便|たくはいびん}: home delivery service
